review_text: Honestly, the coffee truck name isnt enticing as it sounds but their coffee left me shocked jud 😂 lami gud sya ay, didnt expect their coffee would taste closer to “pickup” coffee. Superb for its price. Would recommend this for people na naga doubt pa. No bias review. They deserved it :>
The ambiance is so cozy and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to read a book or catch up with friends. The soft lighting and comfortable seating are a huge plus
I recommend their dirty matcha! it's the perfect balance of earthy matcha and strong espresso.
The drinks are very affordable and the staff is quick to make the drinks 💛
Their coffees are really delicious.. But their staff is also very nice.. Highly recommended.. 👍👍👍💯
